content: <thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant ion at m/z 224.120, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.1128 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 17 % M+1, negligible M+2) indicates a molecule composed mainly of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen, with about 16 carbons (16 × 1.1 % ≈ 17 % M+1). Calculating exact masses shows that C₁₆H₁₅O matches the observed neutral mass within a few ppm (exact mass 223.11229 Da). Thus the molecular formula is C₁₆H₁₅O.
